meta.name: Manslaughter
meta.description:
From IMDb: Society girl and thrill-seeker Lydia causes the death of a motorcycle policeman, and is prosecuted by her fiancé, Daniel, who describes in lurid detail the downfall of Rome. While she's in prison she reforms, and Daniel becomes a wasted alcoholic.

Stars: Thomas Meighan, Leatrice Joy, and Lois Wilson
